attributes.name: Crystal Mail
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 1d4 to your Perception check. 

When you would discard cards as Combat or Mental damage, recharge this card to instead recharge up to 2 of those cards.

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with light armors, bury it instead.
